description: This is one of the offers on the second Merchants card. This is a track card where you can spend persons and [money] to gain [vp] and [tradegoods]. Note though, that this card does not have a Time Effect but a Passive Effect. This means that your turn doesn't end when you use this effect, in contrast to many other track cards. This means you can do this any number of times during your turn, as long as you pay the persons AND [money] required for each box. Remember to put the [tradegoods] you gain for each claim to good use!
